newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Gonzalez to lead OSCE Yugoslavia mission.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Gonzalez to lead OSCE Yugoslavia mission.

text.p: Former Spanish Prime Minister Felipe Gonzalez will head a European observer group to investigate disputed local elections in former Yugoslavia, his party said on Tuesday.

Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic, under pressure from mass street protests over alleged fraud in municipal elections, has offered to allow the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) to probe the fairness of the poll.

"The Secretary General of the PSOE (Socialist party) has accepted the OSCE's request to head the mission investigating the results of the elections in Serbia," said a statement by Gonzalez's opposition Socialist party.

European leaders, meeting in Dublin last week, set conditions for an international team to verify the regularity of last month's elections, including the right to re-run them under international supervision.

Gonzalez lost Spanish elections in March after heading the government for 13 years, discredited by a series of scandals including allegations he masterminded a "dirty war" against the Basque separatist group ETA in which 28 people were killed.
